question:
Refer to the exhibit. What happens to the VRRP configuration when the router SW9621-2 becomes operational?
SW9621-1# show vrrp detail
Ethernet2/3 - Group 100 (IPV4)
  State is Master
  Virtual IP address is 192.168.30.100
  Priority 100, Configured 100
  Forwarding threshold(for VPC), lower: 1 upper: 100
  Advertisement interval 3
  Preemption enabled
  Authentication text "D458F7B032E4632090EF06EE5A"
  Virtual MAC address is 0000.5e00.0164
  Master router is Local
context: Topology: SW9621-1 and SW9621-2 both connect to the Internet via Ethernet2/3. SW9621-2 (VRRP priority 160) is temporarily unavailable.
imageNote: Diagram: SW9621-1 and SW9621-2 both connect to the Internet cloud and to each other via Ethernet2/3; SW9621-2 (VRRP priority 160) is marked temporarily unavailable.
options: The SW9621-2 router becomes a new active master.
The SW9621-1 router becomes a new active master after 3 seconds.
The SW9621-1 router remains an active master.
The SW9621-2 router becomes an active master after 3 seconds.
